title: confed doctor result
description: The `result` of `confed doctor --json`. Any failed check makes the command exit 1; warnings do not.

name.description: Check identity, e.g. `workspace`, `state database`, `gitignore`, `credentials`, `credential store`, `keyring`, `session file permissions`, `frontmatter`, `page files`, `last fetch`, `agent docs`, `converter`, `server`, `capabilities`.

fix_applied.description: True when --fix repaired this check during the run.
